import hashlib,json,importlib.util,time,resource
from pathlib import Path
from pipeline.cohort_checkpoint import verify_checkpoint
assert importlib.util.find_spec('tensorflow') is None
e=json.loads(Path('/tmp/input/expected.json').read_text());sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sha('/experiment/scientific-acquisition.candidate.json')==e['manifest_sha256'];m=json.loads(Path('/experiment/scientific-acquisition.candidate.json').read_text());seen=set();result=[];started=time.monotonic()
for entry in e['entries']:
 scene=entry['scene'];assert scene not in seen and entry['membership']==m['scenes'][scene];seen.add(scene)
 if entry['kind']=='pilot':path=Path(entry['checkpoint'])
 else:
  original=Path(entry['checkpoint']);root=Path(e['working_root']);assert root in original.parents and '..' not in original.parts;path=Path('/source')/original.relative_to(root)
 v=verify_checkpoint(path,expected_checkpoint_sha256=entry['checkpoint_sha256'],code_root='/experiment',expected_runtime_lock=e['runtime_lock'],expected_manifest_sha256=e['manifest_sha256'],expected_source_hashes=entry['source_hashes'],path_remap={e['working_root']:'/source'})
 assert v['scene']==scene
 if entry['kind']=='full':assert v['worker_receipts']==16 and v['verified_evictions']==3
 else:assert entry['kind'] in ('pilot','gap') and v['worker_receipts']==5 and v['verified_evictions']==1
 # Reopen the camera replay attached to each retained checkpoint explicitly.
 checkpoint=json.loads(path.read_text());replay_paths=[p for p in checkpoint['retained_evidence_hashes'] if p.endswith('/camera-replay/receipt.json') or '/camera-replay-' in p and p.endswith('/receipt.json')]
 assert len(replay_paths)==1
 original=Path(replay_paths[0]);relative=original.relative_to(Path(e['working_root']));replay=json.loads((Path('/source')/relative).read_text())
 assert replay['scene']==scene and len(replay['checks'])==2 and all(type(c['exit_code']) is int and c['exit_code']==0 for c in replay['checks'])
 result.append({'scene':scene,'membership':entry['membership'],'kind':entry['kind'],'checkpoint_sha256':entry['checkpoint_sha256'],'camera_validation':replay['validation'],'lifecycle':v})
assert seen==set(m['scenes']) and len(result)==103
value={'scenes':103,'full_checkpoint_scenes':100,'separate_pilot_scenes':1,'recovered_gap_scenes':2,'entries':result,'worker_resources':{'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'peak_rss_kib':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,'rss_scope':'worker_process_peak'},'scope':'complete native camera measurement/annotation publication, two native replays and eviction lineage; model/geometry/protocol scientific comparisons remain open'}
Path('/outputs/check.json').write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n');print('PASS all103 original camera lifecycles independently reconciled',flush=True)
